eyebrow.zh: 少打断 · 会学习 · 本地优先

headline.zh:
你的 agent
不再每一步都打断你
headline.en:
Your agent
stops interrupting you every step

sub.zh: 从你过去标注的决策里学会哪些操作可以自动放行，只在真正陌生的风险上才找你确认——把人工审查从 O(每个动作) 压缩到 O(异常)。
sub.en: Learns from your past decision labels which actions are safe to auto-approve, and only escalates on genuinely novel-risk shapes — collapsing human review from O(every-action) to O(anomaly).

title.zh: 第 50 次 npm install，不再问你
title.en: The 50th npm install, no longer asks

body.zh: 从你的历史标签学会熟悉动作可以安全放行，重复的工具调用自动批准。
body.en: Learns from your history that familiar actions are safe to auto-approve; repetitive tool calls flow through on their own.

chips: › git status / npm install / pytest 预标安全

title.zh: 只在真正陌生的风险上找你
title.en: Only escalates on genuinely novel risk

body.zh: 没见过的动作形状——比如 curl 未知主机再管道给 bash——才上报人工，其余自动放行。
body.en: Unseen action shapes — like curl to an unknown host piped to bash — escalate to you; everything else flows through.

chips: › 新型网络外发管道自动上报
› 熟悉 = 放行，陌生 = 找你

title.zh: 本地一个文件，数据不出境
title.en: One local file, data never leaves

body.zh: 一个进程、一个本地文件、无后台服务。所有标签留在你机器里——这正是企业自托管买家要的那条保证。
body.en: One process, one local file, no backend service. Every label stays on your machine — the guarantee enterprise self-host buyers pay for.

title.zh: 一行接入你的编码 agent
title.en: One line into your coding agent

body.zh: 把打印出来的片段粘进 settings——动作前检查、动作后回写标签——就接上了。冷克隆到第一个自动批准 ≤10 分钟。
body.en: Paste the printed snippet into settings — check before each action, label after — and you're wired in. Cold clone to first auto-approve in ≤10 minutes.

chips: › riskshape init 打印接入片段

headline.zh: 让 agent 学会你信任什么
headline.en: Let your agent learn what you trust

sub.zh: uvx 即装，本地运行，MIT 开源。
sub.en: uvx install, runs locally, MIT open source.

tag.zh: MIT 开源 · 本地优先
